procedure.hyperparameters: lightgbm/full selected configuration per horizon (training OOF), not re-tuned
procedure.folds: 5 patient folds over the variant's training patients, stratified by any creatinine AKI, notebook-02 seed
procedure.rounds: minimum of the mean held-out log-loss curve over the 5 folds; final refit on all of the variant's patients
procedure.weights: inverse patient rows x balanced classes, as notebook 02
procedure.calibration: Platt on the variant's training out-of-fold scores (the source system only)

config.feature_source: stored notebook-01 snapshot features (legacy_prefix_v1, the engine the weights were trained on)
config.size_matching: both variants use the same number of training patients (the smaller system's count, MetaVision); CareVue training patients are subsampled with the seed below, so a transfer gap is not a sample-size effect

evaluation.comparison: on each target system: AUROC(cross-system model) - AUROC(within-system model), and each variant minus the locked model; paired patient bootstrap
evaluation.alerts: policy v3 rule and threshold (24 h >= 0.21 and 12 h >= 0.105, 12 h cooldown) applied unchanged to each model's risks on each target system: does the alert burden move when a model is transported without recalibration?

specification.registration: immutable local record; not public preregistration
